scope: Post-outcome evidence extension on all 35 Yarn-file candidates in the same 215-project frame. Accept only Yarn Classic roots without workspaces, exact nominal SemVer descriptor paths agreed on by both readers, regular edges, canonical registry identifiers and platform-unconditional targets. Skip every edge affected by a named selective resolution. Use exact registry metadata to corroborate transitive declarations. Yarn results can add positive witnesses only. Missing evidence leaves the opposing status unresolved.
artifact_rule: Canonical npm path or canonical Yarn registry mirror path with exact SHA-512 match. Reject a contradictory SHA-512 for either host when both sides provide SHA-512.
temporality: Freeze before new account acquisition. Original npm and pnpm observations remain at their original date. Interpret the combined bounds as a sensitivity to adding these Yarn observations.
